definitions: To be aware of the current situation or public opinion and how it is likely to develop.
To understand the prevailing mood or trend and adapt one's actions accordingly.
examples: A good politician always knows which way the wind blows.
She's very good at knowing which way the wind blows in the office.
You need to know which way the wind blows before making a big decision.
lemma: know which way the wind blows
synonyms: have your ear to the ground
source: know which way the wind blows
